experiment_protocol.fit_source: Three explicit TRAIN captures only; no DEV or TEST refitting
experiment_protocol.evaluation: Same ordered layer/start/token records and timing sample for every candidate
experiment_protocol.state_accounting: Complete activated serialized state or physical device tensors, whichever is larger, once per full cache
experiment_protocol.rate_objective: Compare actual complete packet bytes and decoder state; fit objectives are separately recorded by each model
experiment_protocol.exactness: Original BF16 words; verified upstream replay plus exact correction fallback; complete DEV continuation representatives
experiment_protocol.logging: Per-record components, model/probability identities, prediction/correction diagnostics, fallback decisions, encode/decode/transfer times and isolated allocation peaks
experiment_protocol.decoder_scope: Selected-device eager tensor implementations; no implicit CPU entropy decode
experiment_protocol.decision_scope: All fixed outcomes retained. TEST summaries are descriptive, not a TEST-trained online selector
experiment_protocol.raw_capture_policy: Reports/state only; original hidden tensors and raw KV are not exported
experiment_protocol.serving_scope: Raw KV remains resident. No compact-attention, concurrency, capacity or serving-speedup result is inferred
